# Simulation Truth

- Synthetic chr10 marker panel, two synthetic ancestry groups, and known
  sibling-pair family membership.
- A null trait with deliberately programmed ancestry-group confounding; no
  marker is causal.
- Genotype PCs and a realized genomic relationship matrix.

# Required Results

- Genotype matrix, phenotype/family table, naive and adjusted marker p-values,
  lambda/frequency metrics, and validation summary.

# Required Figures

- Genotype PCA colored by synthetic ancestry group.
- Realized genomic relationship matrix.
- QQ plot for naive association.
- QQ plot for PC-plus-family/kinship-proxy adjustment.

# Pass Criteria

- The output contains only the declared synthetic null trait.
- Both p-value scans and the figure exist.
- For the fixed benchmark seed, adjusted genomic inflation is lower than naive
  genomic inflation. This checks the programmed calibration mechanism only.
